texts.zh: 来自[From.GetName]的尊贵[From.GetSpeciesNamePluralCompliment]，我们认为你们是一支具有巨大潜力的种群。虽说你们年纪尚轻，却似乎能够理解生物与社会多样性的重要性，在面对不同的生物与社会时不会尽全力压制或进行摧毁，反而会予以理解和接受。不幸的是，并不是所有年轻种群都具有这种智慧。尤其是[FallenEmpireTaskTarget.GetName]，他们一直在排除异己。我们不便直接进行干涉，所以希望能够将阻止恶行的任务交给你方。对他们发起攻击，阻止他们进行人口净化。我们将感激不尽。
texts.en: Honorable [From.GetSpeciesNamePluralCompliment] of the [From.GetName], we believe you to be a species of great promise. Though you are still young, you seem to understand and value the importance of biological and societal diversity who seek to understand and accept that which is different, rather than suppress and destroy it. Unfortunately, not all of the younger races are so wise. The [FallenEmpireTaskTarget.GetName], in particular, appear to take pride in "cleansing" the galaxy of all forms of life they deem unsuitable. While we cannot intervene ourselves directly, we would like to charge your government with the task of bringing an end to their evil deeds. Attack them and force them to ban the practice of purging, and we will be most grateful indeed.

label.zh: 我们会制止错误行为的！
label.en: We will stop any further atrocities!

label.zh: 7200天计时器到期，且未在战争中
label.en: The 7200-day timer runs out while not at war

我方自己允许清洗（平均10天）

label.en: We do not wish a conflict with the [FallenEmpireTaskTarget.GetName].

texts.zh: [FallenEmpireTaskOrigin.GetName]要求我们制止正在[FallenEmpireTaskTarget.GetName]发生的错误行为。我们需要对他们开战，强迫他们结束种群消灭的行径。
texts.en: The [FallenEmpireTaskOrigin.GetName] have asked us to stop the ongoing atrocities in the [FallenEmpireTaskTarget.GetName]. We will need to make war on them and force them to end their genocidal practices.

texts.zh: 我们真是失望透顶啊，[From.GetSpeciesName]。你们许诺要阻止[FallenEmpireTaskTarget.GetName]的一切不当行为，现在却看到他们仍然肆意妄为、横行霸道。我们曾以为你们能够阻止他们，但现在看来，是我们搞错了。
texts.en: We are most disappointed, young [From.GetSpeciesName]. Despite your promise to end their evil practices, the [FallenEmpireTaskTarget.GetName] continue to purge and slaughter at will. We thought your species one of great promise, but perhaps we were mistaken.

texts.zh: 你好，年轻的[From.GetSpeciesName]。前一阵我们要求你们阻止[FallenEmpireTaskTarget.GetName]的人口净化行为。目前看来，我们的要求已经没有必要了，因为[FallenEmpireTaskTarget.GetSpeciesName]已经下令禁止了这种活动。不知这是出于他人的胁迫还是自愿为之，反正已经没有必要对他们进行攻击了。
texts.en: Greetings, young [From.GetSpeciesName]. A while ago we tasked you with ending the practice of purging in the [FallenEmpireTaskTarget.GetName]. It appears our request is no longer necessary, as the [FallenEmpireTaskTarget.GetSpeciesName] have already banned the practice. Whether forced to by others or electing to do so themselves, there is no longer a need for aggressive action against them.

texts.zh: 这是怎么回事，[From.GetSpeciesName]？！你是想开玩笑吗？！你们不仅没能制止[FallenEmpireTaskTarget.GetName]的错误行为，居然还打算效仿他们！作为正义的一方，我们绝不会姑息。
texts.en: What is this, young [From.GetSpeciesName]?! Do you think to mock us?! Not only do you fail in stopping the atrocities in the [FallenEmpireTaskTarget.GetName], you have now elected to legalize those very same practices in your own empire! Know that we will not be made fools of. There will be repercussions for this, mark my words.

tooltips.zh: [FallenEmpireTaskOrigin.GetName]一定会十分不满，搞不好还会教训我们一番。
tooltips.en: [FallenEmpireTaskOrigin.GetName] will be most displeased, and may decide to teach us a lesson.

# 来自堕落帝国的任务：制止错误行为 / Task: Stop Atrocities

- 分类 Category: C8 银河轶事 / C8 Galactic miscellany · 来源 Sources: events/fallen_empire_tasks_events.txt:955-1390; common/on_actions/00_on_actions.txt:599 · 审阅 Reviewed 2026-10-13

## 如何开始 How it starts

异种友好的堕落帝国要求制止纯化：五年随机脉冲（on_five_year_random_pulse_country_fe_list，common/on_actions/00_on_actions.txt:595-614）把本任务作为候选；各候选权重相对980，抽中后仍须通过其触发条件。（权重40，平等主义/亲外×2，威权/排外×0.5。）条件：非AI默认国家，非机器/蜂巢/终结者/吞噬/净化，禁止奴役与清洗，不在战争中，没有进行中的同类任务；一个狂热亲外、对我方“庇护”或“轻视”的堕落帝国要求我方制止与我方为对手的、允许清洗且被我方视为灭绝性的国家。

A xenophile fallen empire asks us to stop another empire's purges: The five-year random pulse (on_five_year_random_pulse_country_fe_list, common/on_actions/00_on_actions.txt:595-614) lists this task among its candidates; weights are out of 980 and the event's own trigger must still pass. (weight 40; egalitarian/xenophile x2, authoritarian/xenophobe x0.5.) Conditions: a human default country that is not machine, hive, terminator, devouring or purifier, bans slavery and purging, is not at war and has no such task running; a fanatic-xenophile fallen empire patronizing or dismissive toward us names one of our rivals that allows purging and has a genocidal opinion of us.

## 剧情脉络 Story outline

fallen_empires_tasks.8：接受（a）则开始“任务：制止错误行为”事件链，并设定7200天（约20年）计时器；拒绝（b）则对方不悦。之后没有成功窗口——成功事件 fallen_empires_tasks.9 在游戏文件中被注释掉（L1135-1178）。链只有失败的几种终局：计时器到期且不在战争中的 fallen_empires_tasks.10（“失望”）；对象国不再清洗的 .11（“已不再需要”，平均10天）；任务承接国自己合法化清洗的 .13（愤怒）；以及参与国失效时静默终止的隐藏事件 .12。

fallen_empires_tasks.8: accepting (a) starts the "Task: Stop Atrocities" chain with a 7200-day (about 20 years) timer; refusing (b) displeases the empire. There is no success window - the success event fallen_empires_tasks.9 is commented out in the game files (L1135-1178). The chain has only failure endings: fallen_empires_tasks.10 (disappointed) when the timer runs out and we are not at war; .11 (no longer needed, mean 10 days) when the target stops purging; .13 (angry) when the task-taker legalises purging itself; and hidden .12 which silently ends it if a party becomes invalid.

## 分支与结局 Branches and outcomes

10 / 11 / 13 互斥（每个都清理任务旗标）。

10 / 11 / 13 are exclusive (each clears the task flags).
